Messages.Author: Eric L. Coker
Messages.Body:
Hey Tom...
I know that I saw a previous post about these questions being sent ti the
design team, but I was wondering if there had been any official ruling yet.

When someone's prey is ousted, does the predator immediately receive the
6 blood or does that wait until the end of the turn? If you do have to
wait until the end of the turn, would it be the end of the turn that your
prey was ousted or (if another player did the ousting) would you have to
wait until your turn rolls around?

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Eric L. Coker <afn0...@usenet.freenet.ufl.edu> wrote:
>I know that I saw a previous post about these questions being sent ti the
>design team, but I was wondering if there had been any official ruling yet.
>When someone's prey is ousted, does the predator immediately receive the

>6 blood or does that wait until the end of the turn?...

You get the 6 blood immediately. My confusion was caused by misinterpreting
the part under "winning the game" about how if multiple players are ousted
by a single action, only those players who survive that get their blood
for their pray getting whacked. So player A and player B (who is A's prey)
get ousted by a Conservative Agitation, only player C (A's predator)
gets any blood for it, though A still gets a victory point and B's ante.
